body: 8 years ago today, Kodak Black, Travis Scott, and Offset released “ZEZE” The song took off before it even dropped, with Kodak’s studio snippet going viral and fans already hooked on the beat. Travis Scott opens the track with the catchy hook before Offset comes in with his signature delivery. The three artists each bring something different to the song, and the beat made “ZEZE” stand out from everything else coming out at the time.

source_caption_text:
8 years ago today, Kodak Black, Travis Scott, and Offset released “ZEZE”

The song took off before it even dropped, with Kodak’s studio snippet going viral and fans already hooked on the beat.

Travis Scott opens the track with the catchy hook before Offset comes in with his signature delivery. The three artists each bring something different to the song, and the beat made “ZEZE” stand out from everything else coming out at the time.

Kodak closes it out with his laid-back delivery, reminding everyone why the song had to be his. “ZEZE” went on to peak at No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and became one of the biggest rap songs of 2018. Eight years later, that beat is still instantly recognizable.
